text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
I knew that Rin could accomplish whatever she put her mind to, but it
turns out she's super tenacious too. I'm going to work even harder so
that she doesn't make me look bad.
choice_data_list: She's doing it for her friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
リンちゃんはやればできる子だと思ってたけど、
本当にすごいがんばりよね。
私も負けないように
たくさん働くわ！

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, I'm also one to miss watching her laze around...
I wouldn't tell her that, but it's part and parcel of peaceful times
at our ranch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
と思いつつ、
ダラけてる姿が
恋しくなってる私もいるのよね……
リンちゃんには言わないけど、
あれも平和な牧場
って感じだったし。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
A reward for Rin...? What is there other than time off work?
Acorns... are something she seems to enjoy gathering on her own.
Maybe we could play one of her games with her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
リンちゃんへのご褒美……
休み以外に何かあるかしら。
ドングリ……
は
自分で集めるのも楽しんでそうだし。
一緒にゲームとか、
できたらいいのにな。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
She'd probably get embarrassed and dodge the subject, but she really
does care a lot about Elizabeth Park. I just wish she'd be a little more
honest about her feelings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
リンちゃんは照れてごまかすでしょうけど、
本当に牧場のことを大切に思ってるわよね。
もう少し素直になってくれればいいのに。
